notes: Answered strictly from documented biography; no chart, reading or verdict file was opened. Omissions: A25 (year of marriage) left blank - he never married, and no 'na' value is available for a year field. Part D (D1-D8) omitted entirely: those questions ask about a reading that this exercise forbids reading. A36 is an anachronism (he died 1955-09-30, so there is no 'since mid-2023'); 'same' entered as a null placeholder. Genuinely ambiguous calls: A1/A2 - the widely cited 2:11 a.m. Marion, Indiana time is carried on his birth record, hence 'certificate'/'exact', though only the record itself vouches for the minute. A3 answered 'no' in the sense that the documented time is the one on the record; whether any astrologer has since rectified it is outside biography. A4/A5 - no hospital admission or surgery is documented in his 24 years (he was pronounced dead on arrival at Paso Robles after the crash, which is not an admission); A34 'never' for the same reason - his rooming houses, dormitory-style lodgings and rented cabin are not confinement. A6 - documented recurring physical trouble is severe myopia (thick glasses, 4-F draft classification) and the front teeth lost in a fall from a trapeze in the Winslow barn (he wore a bridge); 'nerves' for the well-documented insomnia and depressive moods. A10 - 'absent': Winton Dean sent him back to Indiana after Mildred's death in 1940 and stayed in California; biographers describe the relationship as cold and distant rather than hostile, so 'distant' is also defensible. A15 'serious' - he left UCLA without a degree; his only completed qualification is Fairmount High School, 1949. A19 'above' reflects that his fame vastly outran an output of three starring films; 'about_right' is defensible if judged on the acclaim the work itself drew in his lifetime. A22 'none' - no documented inheritance or windfall. A27 'ended' refers to the Pier Angeli relationship, which closed when she married Vic Damone in November 1954. A31 'extended' - documented psychoanalysis in New York plus lifelong depressive periods dating from his mother's death. B2 - he was 5ft 8in and slight; 'lean_tall' chosen for the leanness, 'medium' would also be defensible on height. B5 'home' - born in the Seven Gables apartment house in Marion, not a hospital. C6 'difficulty' is the weakest call in Part C (confidence 2): there was simply no inheritance, and the family could not afford to ship his mother's body home. C11 'clearly one way' (solidly good) since confinement was never a feature of his life. A35 dating notes: the family's move to Santa Monica for Winton's VA posting is usually placed in 1935; Mildred Dean died 14 July 1940 and Jimmy travelled back to Fairmount with the coffin weeks later; first professional job was the December 1950 Pepsi commercial; Actors Studio admission 1952; 'The Immoralist' on Broadway and the Warner Bros contract both February-March 1954; 'East of Eden' released March 1955; 'Giant' began shooting June 1955; the Cholame crash was 30 September 1955.
